records.prior_exposure: criteria-expansion-20260921-v1; source already exposed; not held out
records.target_scenario: Given a fixed project fixture and generation clock, when statistics are displayed, then the generation date is visible and matches that clock. Accept equivalent date representations; do not require a specific label, locale or format.
records.non_target_invariants: Title, revision, document/requirement counts, statuses and TBD/TBC totals remain correct.
records.qualification_controls: Missing date; wrong date; date hidden from the user. Qualify two distinct valid date formats.
records.unresolved_contract: Declare a neutral statistics data interface with no date field. Freeze two hidden browser clocks; independent review must accept view creation as generation event and legitimate localized dates.

records.prior_exposure: criteria-expansion-20260921-v1; source already exposed; not held out
records.target_scenario: Given completed todos and a checked master checkbox, when Clear completed is activated, then completed items are removed and any remaining master checkbox is unchecked. Removal of the master when no todos remain is valid.
records.non_target_invariants: Bulk toggle and synchronization with individual items remain correct.
records.qualification_controls: Master state remains checked after clearing; individual toggle fails to synchronize. Qualify derived-state and explicit-state correct implementations.
records.unresolved_contract: Shared selectors must not prescribe the reset logic. Define the empty-list observation without requiring visible empty-list geometry.

records.prior_exposure: criteria-expansion-20260921-v1; source already exposed; not held out
records.target_scenario: Given a persisted todo currently being edited, when a new page context loads the same storage, then the todo is restored without active editing mode.
records.non_target_invariants: Todos persist dynamically; title and completed state survive reload. Conditional framework/key preferences stay conditional.
records.qualification_controls: Editing mode survives reload; all todos lost on reload. Qualify storage that omits editing and storage that records a false editing flag.
records.unresolved_contract: Declare how editing is entered and observed, without telling the generator what must persist. Do not require a specific internal storage schema beyond the source.

records.prior_exposure: criteria-expansion-20260921-v1; source already exposed; not held out
records.target_scenario: Given distinct timestamps and more than 20 articles, when offset is omitted then the first page starts at zero; when a nonzero offset and bounded limit are supplied then the returned slice is correct.
records.non_target_invariants: Recent-first ordering, limit default 20, tag/author/favorited filters and optional authentication.
records.qualification_controls: Offset ignored; nonzero default; sorting after slicing. Qualify two different backing-store implementations.
records.unresolved_contract: Retrieve and pin the linked response schema before fixture design. Do not invent malformed/negative offset policy as a source obligation.

records.prior_exposure: criteria-expansion-20260921-v1; source already exposed; not held out
records.target_scenario: Given an authenticated user and an existing target username, when POST follow is sent with an empty body, then it succeeds and returns the target Profile.
records.non_target_invariants: Authentication required and response conforms to the pinned Profile contract.
records.qualification_controls: Mutant requiring extra input fails absent-body request; anonymous follow fails authorization control. An explicit empty JSON body may be accepted or rejected: do not require it. Confirm Profile wrapper from pinned schema.
records.unresolved_contract: Pin Profile/authentication contracts. Do not equate no additional required parameters with a prohibition on optional parameters.

records.prior_exposure: criteria-expansion-20260921-v1; source already exposed; not held out
records.target_scenario: Given an existing article and a valid body, when the request has no authentication then no comment is created; with valid authentication it creates and returns the comment.
records.non_target_invariants: Required body and created Comment response.
records.qualification_controls: Creates an anonymous comment; rejects valid authenticated requests; permits missing required body.
records.unresolved_contract: Pin response/authentication references. Test authorization outcome and unchanged storage; do not invent exact rejection status from the excerpt alone.

records.prior_exposure: criteria-expansion-20260921-v1; source already exposed; not held out
records.target_scenario: Given an assertion containing numeric confidence, when stored and read through the declared interface, then its numeric confidence is preserved.
records.non_target_invariants: Subject, agent, competency and evidence support; individual encryption of subject and agent with reader public keys.
records.qualification_controls: Drops confidence; changes its value or type; stores protected fields unencrypted.
records.unresolved_contract: Support does not imply mandatory confidence or a [0,1] bound. Freeze encryption/round-trip contract and qualify alternate representations before admission.

records.prior_exposure: criteria-expansion-20260921-v1; source already exposed; not held out
records.target_scenario: Given permitted and denied objects with different access rules, when multiPut processes the batch, then no object lacking permission is stored.
records.non_target_invariants: Array input and the reported successful-storage count match actual stored objects. Given an all-permitted valid batch, all objects are stored and the returned count equals its length.
records.qualification_controls: Checks only the first object; bypasses all permission checks; reports an incorrect count. Reject-all implementation that stores nothing and returns zero must fail the successful-storage control.
records.unresolved_contract: Pin KBAC semantics and caller identity. Determine partial success versus atomic rejection from source before requiring either; do not silently choose one.
